headline: Committee approves recognition of length of service when assigning pensions between the Kyrgyz Republic and Uzbekistan
summary: A committee of the Kyrgyz Jogorku Kenesh approved in first reading a bill to ratify an agreement with Uzbekistan on counting work experience when assigning pensions. The bill still requires further readings.
why: Bilateral labour and pension agreements affect cross-border workers' benefit entitlements. The effect on markets is limited.
original_headline: Комитет одобрил учет стажа при назначении пенсий между КР и Узбекистаном
